title: 青函隧道~Seikan Tunnel
focus: 海底岩盤、先進坑與長期水壓管理~Subsea rock, exploratory galleries and long-term pressure management
summary: 青函隧道把本州與北海道鐵路相連，JR北海道公開資料列總長53.85公里並於1988年開始營業。本課以海底地質預報、灌漿及水壓管理建立施工到維護的連續視角，再討論軌道、氣動、救援及設備可用性；所有計算均另列假設，不把公開總長當成每個模型的輸入。~Seikan connects the railways of Honshu and Hokkaido; JR Hokkaido reports a total length of 53.85 km and service beginning in 1988. This course links subsea forecasting, grouting and pressure management across construction and maintenance, then examines track, aerodynamics, rescue and availability. Numerical assumptions remain separate from published dimensions.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 將青函總長與真正海底段分開，檢查兩端陸域接線及坡度對列車和維護進出時間的影響。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Separate Seikan total length from its undersea portion and assess approach gradients and access for trains and maintenance. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=14 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為15.4 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=14 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 15.4 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用縱斷面標出陸海邊界及共同比較端點。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Mark land-sea boundaries and common comparison endpoints on the profile. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把總長全當海底長度會誤述暴露環境與工程數量。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Treating total length as undersea length misstates exposure and quantities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用縱斷面標出陸海邊界及共同比較端點。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Seikan Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Mark land-sea boundaries and common comparison endpoints on the profile. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 青函情境的先進坑資料需在主孔到達前更新，重點是裂隙連通和水路而非只推估完整岩石強度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Update exploratory-gallery evidence before the main heading arrives, emphasising connected fractures and water paths rather than intact strength alone. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=250 m²。Q=k i A=0.000525 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0005775 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=250 m². Q=k i A=0.000525 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0005775 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照先進孔壓力回復與主孔後續揭露，標記未命中的裂隙。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare probe-pressure recovery with later exposure and mark missed fractures. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 某孔無水不代表相鄰未探範圍缺乏連通水路。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~A dry probe does not exclude connected water paths in neighbouring untested ground. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：對照先進孔壓力回復與主孔後續揭露，標記未命中的裂隙。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Seikan Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare probe-pressure recovery with later exposure and mark missed fractures. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 海面並非所有裂隙唯一測壓基準，青函教材把補注、排水和封閉區水頭分開，檢查永久外壓。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Sea level is not the sole head reference for every fracture; separate recharge, drainage and sealed-zone heads when assessing permanent pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=52 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=510.12 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為561.132 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=52 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=510.12 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 561.132 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在共同高程比較不同孔位壓力及抽排變化。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare pressure and drainage changes at different locations on one elevation datum. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以排水孔低壓代表整個襯砌外側會漏掉隔離高壓區。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Using drain pressure for the entire lining misses isolated high-pressure zones. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：在共同高程比較不同孔位壓力及抽排變化。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Seikan Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare pressure and drainage changes at different locations on one elevation datum. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 同條件入流減量~Equal-condition inflow reduction
units.title: 裂隙封水與試驗前後比較~Fracture sealing and before-after testing
units.mechanism: 以青函海底封水背景研究灌漿前後水路重分配，注入量、壓力與剩餘滲透性必須分別判讀。岩體灌漿意在改變連通裂隙的水力傳導，注入體積不等於留下的有效封水體積。比較前後入流必須保持壓力、水頭和試段邊界一致，否則自然衰減或排水重分配也會降低讀值；灌漿效果要由水力試驗、鄰孔反應和後續揭露共同驗證。~Study flow redistribution around hypothetical subsea grouting, interpreting injected volume, pressure and residual permeability separately. Rock grouting changes hydraulic conductance of connected fractures, and injected volume is not retained effective sealing volume. Before-and-after flow must use equal pressure, head and test boundaries; natural decay or redirected drainage can also reduce the reading. Hydraulic tests, neighbouring-hole response and later exposure jointly establish the interpretation rather than injection quantity alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：試前同壓流量=0.013 m³/s；試後同壓流量=0.0035 m³/s。r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=73.0769 %。僅把試後同壓流量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為70.3846 %。邊界：相同水頭與試段的流量減量，不是全岩體封水率或長期保證；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: flow before at equal pressure=0.013 m³/s; flow after at equal pressure=0.0035 m³/s. r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=73.0769 %. Increasing only flow after at equal pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 70.3846 %. Boundary: Flow reduction at equal head and test interval, not whole-rock sealing efficiency or long-term assurance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較試段注前注後的同條件水力試驗及鄰孔反應。重複相同水頭和試段長度的水力試驗，同步觀察鄰孔壓力與出水，保存注漿歷程和試驗時間。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare before-and-after hydraulic tests under equal conditions and observe neighbouring holes. Repeat tests at equal head and interval length, observe neighbouring pressure and flow and preserve injection histories and test timing. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 大量吃漿可能流向遠端裂隙，不能單獨證明近掌子面已封閉。注漿流入遠端裂隙或形成局部封口，可能使單孔出水減少但主水路仍連通；改變測試水頭也會造成假性改善。~High grout take may enter distant fractures without sealing the face vicinity. Grout entering distant fractures or sealing only a collar can reduce one outlet while the main path remains connected; changed test head also creates apparent improvement.
units.misconception: 單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。~Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
units.practice: 本案「同條件入流減量」的交付需回答：比較試段注前注後的同條件水力試驗及鄰孔反應。把注入量、同條件水力結果和未覆蓋區分開交付，任何封水判斷保留替代水路及後續確認需求，不以教材減量當現場允收。~For Seikan Tunnel, the equal-condition inflow reduction handover must address the following evidence: Compare before-and-after hydraulic tests under equal conditions and observe neighbouring holes. Hand over injection quantity, equal-condition hydraulic results and untested areas separately, retaining alternative paths and follow-up checks rather than using classroom reduction as field acceptance.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 長期出水與施工擾動使青函案例適合比較支護初期荷重和後續襯砌功能，不把暫時穩定當永久證明。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Compare initial support loading with later lining functions under water exposure and excavation disturbance, without equating temporary stability with permanent adequacy. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=35 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=315 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為346.5 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=35 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=315 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 346.5 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將支護荷重、收斂與水頭變化分階段對齊。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align support force, convergence and head change by stage. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 水壓回升造成的荷載若歸為岩體擠壓，會選錯分析機制。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Attributing pressure-recovery loads to squeezing selects the wrong mechanism. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將支護荷重、收斂與水頭變化分階段對齊。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Seikan Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Align support force, convergence and head change by stage. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 青函鐵路背景用來分析不同列車質量的坡度功率，另保留軌距、車輛限界及營運規則的獨立介面。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~Use Seikan railway context to compare grade power by train mass while retaining separate gauge, vehicle-envelope and operating-rule interfaces. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.3e+06 kg；縱坡=0.006 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1530.36 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1683.4 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.3e+06 kg; grade=0.006 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1530.36 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1683.4 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將假想列車質量和速度與所用坡度逐項列清。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~State hypothetical mass and speed explicitly against the gradient used. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 坡度功率相近不代表不同車種可互換通行條件。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Similar grade power does not make different vehicle operating envelopes interchangeable. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：將假想列車質量和速度與所用坡度逐項列清。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For Seikan Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: State hypothetical mass and speed explicitly against the gradient used. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.anchor: 入口壓力擾動~Portal pressure disturbance
units.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級~Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
units.mechanism: 長海底鐵路的列車氣動需辨認壓力波與通風基線，教學動壓只提供速度平方的尺度。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。~Separate train pressure waves from baseline ventilation in a long subsea railway; teaching dynamic pressure provides only velocity-squared scaling. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=45 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1470.15 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=45 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1470.15 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把慢變通風壓差納入波峰會誤判車速對波幅的影響。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。~Including slow ventilation pressure in the peak biases the inferred speed-wave relationship. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.
units.misconception: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。~A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。~For Seikan Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

units.anchor: 剩餘集水容積~Remaining sump volume
units.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積~Outage buffer and effective sump volume
units.mechanism: 青函長期抽排情境需同時追蹤集水容量、設備可用與補注持續性，假想停電時間不是操作允許值。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。~Track sump reserve, availability and continuing recharge in long-term drainage; a hypothetical outage duration is not an operating allowance. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=400 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為31.8979 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=400 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 31.8979 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 泵運轉指示不保證實際出流，管阻變化可令流量下降。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。~A running indication does not ensure discharge when pipe resistance changes. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.
units.misconception: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。~Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。~For Seikan Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 海底鐵路救援需要區分步行、列車運送與通訊延遲，青函案例的長距離使起始位置假設特別重要。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Distinguish walking, train-assisted movement and communication delay; long subsea distances make initial location assumptions particularly important. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=90 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=540 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為585 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=90 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=540 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 585 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只選靠近避難點的停車位置會低估不利情境的時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Selecting only stops near refuge points understates adverse-scenario time. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Seikan Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 青函長期營運資料用來建立滲漏點到設備工單的關聯，區分季節水量、測器漂移與病害擴張。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Link leakage locations to maintenance records, distinguishing seasonal flow, sensor drift and expanding defects in long-term operation. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=105 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.2381 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=105 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.2381 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 位置編碼改版未對照會把同一漏點誤認成多個新缺陷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Unmapped identifier changes make one leak appear to be several new defects. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Seikan Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「基線縱坡與牽引需求」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=250 m²。Q=k i A=0.000525 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0005775 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：列車質量=1.3e+06 kg；縱坡=0.006 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1530.36 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1683.4 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate base-alignment grade and traction demand. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=250 m². Q=k i A=0.000525 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0005775 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.3e+06 kg; grade=0.006 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1530.36 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1683.4 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1988 年公開記錄：青函隧道於3月13日開始營業。青函隧道把本州與北海道鐵路相連，JR北海道公開資料列總長53.85公里並於1988年開始營業。本課以海底地質預報、灌漿及水壓管理建立施工到維護的連續視角，再討論軌道、氣動、救援及設備可用性；所有計算均另列假設，不把公開總長當成每個模型的輸入。本課把「海底岩盤、先進坑與長期水壓管理」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1988: Seikan Tunnel begins commercial operation on 13 March. Seikan connects the railways of Honshu and Hokkaido; JR Hokkaido reports a total length of 53.85 km and service beginning in 1988. This course links subsea forecasting, grouting and pressure management across construction and maintenance, then examines track, aerodynamics, rescue and availability. Numerical assumptions remain separate from published dimensions. The course treats subsea rock, exploratory galleries and long-term pressure management as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 53.85 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 53.85 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1988 年事件：青函隧道於3月13日開始營業。~1988 event: Seikan Tunnel begins commercial operation on 13 March.
教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=14 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=14 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=14 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 14 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.000525 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=1e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.000525 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「支護安裝時點」：局部剛度=35 kN/mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=315 kN；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching support activation time: local stiffness=35 kN/mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 315 kN; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「坡度阻力功率」：列車質量=1.3e+06 kg，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1530.36 kW；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching grade-resistance power: train mass=1.3e+06 kg, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1530.36 kW; not measured or accepted project data.
